name: Travel Pace
description: Fast, normal, and slow travel paces affect distance traveled and perception or stealth.

name: Falling
description: A creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen, up to 20d6, and lands prone unless it avoids the damage.

name: Suffocating
description: A creature can hold its breath for 1 + Constitution modifier minutes (minimum 30 seconds); after running out of breath, it survives a limited number of rounds before dropping to 0 HP.

name: Vision and Light
description: Lightly obscured areas impose disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks; heavily obscured areas block vision.
